ios.desc:
Receipt scanner and expense tracker for everyone who keeps receipts for taxes, reimbursement or business expenses. Snap a receipt and ReceiptGenie reads the merchant, date, total, tax and every line item for you.

SCAN ANY RECEIPT
• Scan paper receipts with the camera, several pages in one go
• Import photos and PDF receipts, or share them from other apps
• AI reads merchant, total, tax, tip, discounts and line items, in many languages
• Receipts in another currency get a converted total based on historical exchange rates

ORGANIZE AND FIND EVERY RECEIPT
• Your receipt organizer and receipt keeper: every receipt stays searchable
• Tag receipts and single line items; AI suggests tags as you go
• Add notes, translate receipt text, or re-process a scan with feedback
• Search by merchant, item or note

TRACK EXPENSES
• See spending by month, by tag and by merchant
• Keep business expenses and personal purchases apart with tags
• Ready for tax time: tax receipts and deductible expenses in one place

EXPENSE REPORTS IN SECONDS (PREMIUM)
• Build an expense report for any date range
• Export to PDF, CSV or Excel (XLSX), or a ZIP file with the receipt images
• Send it to your accountant, your manager or your bookkeeping software

MADE FOR
• Freelancers and the self-employed getting ready for tax season
• Small business owners tracking business expenses
• Employees who need reimbursement for work expenses
• Travelers with receipts in other languages and currencies

HOW YOUR DATA IS HANDLED
Your receipt library lives on your iPhone, and eligible data syncs through iCloud. Scans are processed by cloud AI services, and receipt files are kept on our servers for processing, recovery and troubleshooting. You can ask support to delete your data at any time.

quotes.text:
I built a receipt organizer and tracker app on iOS in May this year and now it has just past $200 in monthly recurring revenue and >$500 in December. Before this I have been collecting my own receipts and scanning them into a private website I built for myself, then one day I was like, why don't I make it into an app so it is easier to use and I can share it with others?

https://receipt-genie.com
